verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for a browser-infrastructure SaaS, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack says Browserbase's source is published or openly licensed. Community discussion instead presents BrowserStation as an open-source alternative to the commercial Browserbase service, and SDK and framework mentions say nothing about licensing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
